name: AI Hotel Chatbot by Lobbychat
author: lobbychat

sections.description:
Lobbychat is an AI chatbot built specifically for hotels. It helps guests find information quickly and easily by answering questions based on your hotel’s website content.

The WordPress plugin makes it easy to install Lobbychat on your hotel website without editing code. Simply install, enter your Lobbychat ID, and enable the chatbot.

Key Features

  • Simple one-click installation
  • Built specifically for hotels
  • Supports 120+ languages
  • Answers guest questions instantly
  • Mobile-friendly experience
  • Brand color customization
  • Facebook Messenger integration
  • Instagram integration
  • Easy enable / disable controls

How It Works

  1. Install the plugin.
  2. Enter your Lobbychat ID.
  3. Enable the chatbot.
  4. Lobbychat appears on your website.

No coding required.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • Active Lobbychat account — book a free demo

External services

This plugin connects to the Lobbychat service (https://app.lobbychat.ai) in two ways:

1. Chatbot widget script
When the chatbot is enabled, the plugin loads a JavaScript file from https://app.lobbychat.ai/embed/{your-chatbot-id}.js on every public page of your website. This script renders the AI chatbot widget for your guests. No personal visitor data is sent to Lobbychat beyond what the guest types into the chat window.

2. Enable / disable sync
When you toggle the chatbot on or off from the WordPress admin, the plugin sends a request to https://app.lobbychat.ai/api/public/chatbots/{your-chatbot-id}/set-active to keep your widget status in sync with the Lobbychat dashboard. Only the chatbot ID and the enabled/disabled state are transmitted.

This plugin requires an active Lobbychat account. By using this plugin you agree to the Lobbychat Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:

  • Terms of Service: https://lobbychat.ai/terms-conditions/
  • Privacy Policy: https://lobbychat.ai/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the lobbychatai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Lobbychat in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Enter your Lobbychat ID (found in your Lobbychat dashboard under Embed Code).
  5. Toggle the chatbot on.
sections.faq:
What is Lobbychat?

Lobbychat is an AI chatbot built specifically for hotels. It helps guests find information quickly and easily by answering questions based on your hotel’s website content.

Do I need a Lobbychat account?

Yes. An active Lobbychat account is required to use the service. To sign up, get in touch at https://lobbychat.ai/book-free-demo/

Do I need coding knowledge?

No. Simply install the plugin, enter your Lobbychat ID, and enable the chatbot.

Can I disable the chatbot?

Yes. The chatbot can be enabled or disabled at any time from the plugin settings.

Does Lobbychat work on mobile devices?

Yes. Lobbychat is fully responsive and works across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Does the plugin work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. Lobbychat is designed to work with most modern WordPress themes.
